task_definition: Both hands raised with dropper and tube already held -> right hand carries tube to center -> left hand aligns and dispenses -> left and right hands raised again, both objects retained. Exclude dropper pickup, aspiration, return and tube release.

rejected.reason: Right tube lowered around 12-16 s, before left dropper pickup/aspiration 18-34 s. After squeeze around 52 s, left dropper is released around 68.5 s before right tube rises around 75 s. No complete continuous ready-to-ready dispense-only interval.

Tube lowered around 12-16 s; left dropper is repeatedly grasped at 26-32 s and extracted around 34-39 s. Left released at 53.7 s while right tube remains low. Old start includes dropper pickup and ending lacks both held objects raised.

Multiple dropper grasp failures until 67.4 s; right arm starts moving while left is still lifting the dropper around 70-72 s. Missing initial bilateral raised ready pose, with additional retries after squeeze. Excluded from strict complete-cycle set.
User confirmed broken dropper in this original trial; excluded from effective dispensing data.
User confirmed broken dropper in this original trial; excluded from effective dispensing data.

review_method: Every source context contact sheet, every retained start in three views, every squeeze alignment in three views, and every ending at 0.5 s spacing reviewed. Full-frame-rate source movies were not watched frame by frame. EEF xyz is used to capture approach motion before the arm enters ego view.
label_limit: Visual alignment plus commanded squeeze; transferred liquid volume is not measured. No automatic height-only candidate is treated as semantic approval.

segments.review: Full action context sampled at 1 Hz; final start and squeeze verified in all three views; ending compared at 0.5 s spacing; actual EEF xyz and gripper events checked. No model API used.
segments.note: Starts with both objects held and both hands raised before right-arm approach; includes tube transport to center, left alignment and squeeze, then both arms raised again; ends before returning dropper.
